Explain in 4 short sentences what discrete diffusion language models do.<turn|>
<|turn>model
<|channel>thought
<channel|>Discrete diffusion language models generate text by gradually corrupting a sequence of tokens into random noise or mask values. During training, the model learns to reverse this process, transforming noisy input back into coherent, meaningful language. Unlike standard autoregressive models that predict word-by-word, these models can refine the entire sequence simultaneously. This approach allows for more flexible text generation patterns and better handling of global structure within the document.<eos>
